publicationDetails.detailsText: Katrak, Malcolm, and Ishita Chakrabarty, ' Privacy, Political Participation, and Dissent: Facial Recognition Technologies and the Risk of Digital Authoritarianism in the Global South', in Jeroen Temperman, and Alberto Quintavalla (eds), Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights (2023; online edn, Oxford Law Pro)

detail.abstract: The ascendant trend in relation to the use of facial recognition technologies (FRTs) for surveillance purposes across a heterogeneity of regime types and geographical regions has raised concerns pertaining to the erosion of the right to privacy and, in turn, the stymieing of political participation in public spaces. This chapter undertakes an analysis of the right to privacy in the context of FRTs in the Global South. To that end, it will chart the legal framework pertaining to privacy in the Global South, the ramifications of the rampant use of FRTs for privacy and also—importantly—for democratic participation. The authors argue that the centrality of the informational conception of privacy in the existing legal framework provides insufficient safeguards against rising digital authoritarianism. This chapter will, instead, argue in favour of the entrenchment of a broader, overarching right to privacy that accounts for both its decisional and informational aspects, which insulates political participation from the debilitating effects of state surveillance in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球南方国家在面部识别技术（FRTs）监控应用背景下隐私权的保护问题，认为现有法律框架中的信息隐私概念不足以应对数字威权主义的威胁，主张建立更广泛的隐私权保护框架以保障政治参与。
AI.research_question: 在全球南方国家，面部识别技术的广泛监控应用如何影响隐私权保护，以及现有法律框架是否足以保障公民的政治参与免受数字威权主义的侵蚀？
AI.motivation: 面部识别技术在全球各种政体类型和地理区域的监控应用中日益普及，引发了隐私权受到侵蚀的担忧，进而可能阻碍公共空间的政治参与，特别是在全球南方国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐私权的理论框架，特别是信息隐私（informational privacy）与决策隐私（decisional privacy）的区分；数字威权主义理论；全球南方国家的法律框架分析。
AI.method: 法律框架分析；理论论证；比较分析全球南方国家的隐私权保护现状。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架主要依赖信息隐私概念，但不足以应对面部识别技术带来的监控威胁；数字威权主义正在侵蚀隐私权和政治参与；需要更全面的隐私权保护框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将决策隐私和信息隐私相结合的更广泛隐私权理论框架；为全球南方国家的数字权利保护提供了理论分析；丰富了数字威权主义与隐私权关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方国家的政策制定者提供了改进隐私权保护法律框架的建议；为公民社会组织和人权倡导者提供了对抗数字监控的理论工具；为国际人权机制提供了评估数字权利保护的分析框架。

title: Market Demand Analysis and Forecasting Through Applied Econometrics: Empirical Research in the Public Transit Sector in the Toronto City Area (1969–2019)
affiliations: Laval University, Faculté des Sciences Sociales, Département d'Économique, Students

detail.title: Market Demand Analysis and Forecasting Through Applied Econometrics: Empirical Research in the Public Transit Sector in the Toronto City Area (1969–2019)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have received no funding for this paper and have no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could influence or bias its content. I am the sole author of this paper.

detail.abstract: This working paper shall focus on sensitivity analysis, modelling, and forecasting of market demand to cope with uncertainty in the decision-making process. In addition, this paper also aims to provide the reader with an intuitive and practical experience of the optimisation tools of microeconomics, coupled with time series econometrics methods applied with R software. The strong interest in data from the public transit sector in this empirical research is linked to the fact that it is undoubtedly one of the sectors likely to play an important role in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in future smart cities, which is all the more interesting as Toronto is Canada's largest municipality in terms of population. Indeed, public transit is a service that is beneficial to society for all its positive externalities. These benefits include accessibility and social equity in terms of fares and reduced road congestion, and, by extension, the fight against atmospheric pollution by reducing riders' CO2 emissions through public transport. Findings. (i) We shall provide a price-demand sensitivity model (fare in C$) for ridership demand inside the Toronto city area from 1969 to 2019 as well as the derivation of short-and long-term elasticities. We shall also provide, through modelling and forecasting, insight into future demand trends considering pre-and postpandemic scenarios. It is clear that one of the most remarkable points to emerge from the transit data in recent times is that the effects of the pandemic crisis have slowed ridership demand by almost half (225 million riders in 2020) compared to the previous trend (525.5 million riders in 2019) in the City of Toronto (TTC operating service area only), causing a structural break in the time series data, also observed in the TTC's latest report (only 197.8 million riders in 2021). This is not an isolated case for the city of Toronto, as Montreal (only 200 million users in 2020 compared to 426 million in 2019) and most of the major metropolitan cities in the world that were affected also experienced the same slowdown in demand due to reduced activity during the pandemic. (ii) Using our estimated market demand model for transit in the city of Toronto, we will attempt to estimate the optimal price and the price at which consumers are no longer willing to pay. And since this study concerns a public transit company in the form of a natural monopoly commonly referred to as a state monopoly, we shall draw on the seminal work and contributions of Frank Ramsey and Marcel Boiteux (Ramsey-Boiteux pricing rule) to understand the optimal pricing behaviour of this type of network infrastructure. The aim of this research will therefore also be to understand, beyond the elements of microeconomic optimization, that the nature of the company is at the center of its interests, which has a considerable influence on certain aspects that determine its business model and in particular its pricing behaviour (Baumol, 1959).

AI.tldr: 该工作论文聚焦于市场需求的敏感性分析、建模和预测，以应对决策过程中的不确定性。结合微观经济学优化工具和R软件的时间序列计量经济学方法，以多伦多公共交通数据为案例，研究票价需求敏感性模型，推导短期和长期弹性，并分析疫情前后的需求趋势。同时基于自然垄断理论（Ramsey-Boiteux定价规则）探讨公共交通的最优定价策略。
AI.research_question: 1. 如何建立多伦多公共交通票价与需求的敏感性模型并推导弹性系数？2. 疫情如何影响公共交通需求结构？3. 作为自然垄断的公共交通企业如何确定最优定价？
AI.motivation: 公共交通在实现可持续发展目标中扮演重要角色，具有正外部性（可达性、社会公平、减少拥堵和污染）。多伦多作为加拿大最大城市，其公共交通数据具有代表性。疫情导致需求结构断裂，需要新的分析框架来应对不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观经济学优化理论、时间序列计量经济学、Ramsey-Boiteux定价规则（自然垄断定价理论）、Baumol（1959）的企业性质理论。
AI.method: 使用R软件进行时间序列分析，建立价格-需求敏感性模型，推导短期和长期弹性。采用建模和预测方法分析疫情前后需求趋势，应用Ramsey-Boiteux规则进行最优定价分析。
AI.findings: 1. 建立了1969-2019年多伦多公共交通票价-需求敏感性模型，推导了弹性系数。2. 疫情导致需求结构性断裂：2020年乘客量从2019年的5.255亿降至2.25亿（下降近一半），2021年进一步降至1.978亿。3. 蒙特利尔等其他大城市也出现类似需求放缓。4. 将应用模型估计最优价格和消费者支付意愿阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将微观经济学优化工具与时间序列计量经济学方法结合应用于公共交通需求分析。2. 扩展Ramsey-Boiteux定价规则在公共交通自然垄断情境下的应用。3. 为企业性质理论（Baumol, 1959）在公共交通定价行为中的应用提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为公共交通管理者提供需求敏感性分析工具，支持票价决策。2. 提供疫情前后需求预测模型，帮助应对不确定性。3. 为可持续发展目标下的公共交通政策制定提供实证依据。4. 为其他大城市公共交通系统提供可复制的分析框架。

title: Forecast Value Under Adaptive Decision Rules
affiliations: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Students, Norwegian University of Science and Technology  and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

detail.title: Forecast Value Under Adaptive Decision Rules
detail.abstract: Decision-making in finance, energy, and operations is increasingly data-driven, where forecasts provide essential inputs for planning, trading, and operational control. They typically inform decisions through forecast-dependent policies that prescribe how actions should be taken based on the available predictions. However, organizations usually have access to a limited set of forecasting models and cannot obtain a forecast that is perfectly tailored to every decision. This complicates evaluation, as the economic value of a forecast inherently depends on how it is used in decision-making. Traditional forecast evaluation approaches typically ignore this decision context. Instead, they focus primarily on predictive accuracy and compare forecast performance under a single, fixed decision policy, making it difficult to determine whether the observed performance differences reflect forecast quality or the decision policy. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive forecast evaluation framework that assumes decision-makers can adjust their policies in response to forecast performance. We model the decision-maker as a learning agent that selects the policy parameters best suited to each forecast, capturing how AI-enabled decision-support systems adapt their behavior to data. We demonstrate how this adaptation improves economic evaluation and helps isolate the true forecast value using a trading application with day-ahead electricity price forecasts in the German market. We evaluate a rich set of forecasting models alongside decision rules, ranging from simple heuristics to adaptive machine-learning-based policies. Our results show that adaptive decision-aware evaluation policies reduce performance gaps between forecasts and offer a more accurate representation of forecast value in AI-driven decision settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个自适应预测评估框架，通过建模决策者能够根据预测性能调整策略，从而更准确地评估预测在AI驱动决策环境中的经济价值。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑决策上下文的情况下，更准确地评估预测模型的经济价值？具体来说，当决策者能够根据预测性能调整策略时，如何分离预测质量和决策策略对绩效的影响？
AI.motivation: 金融、能源和运营领域的决策日益数据驱动，预测为规划、交易和运营控制提供关键输入。然而，组织通常只能获得有限的预测模型，且无法为每个决策定制完美预测。传统预测评估方法忽略决策上下文，仅关注预测准确性，难以区分观察到的绩效差异是源于预测质量还是决策策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应预测评估框架，将决策者建模为学习代理，能够根据预测性能选择最适合每个预测的策略参数，捕捉AI决策支持系统如何适应数据的行为。
AI.method: 使用德国市场日前电价预测的交易应用进行实证研究。评估丰富的预测模型和决策规则，从简单启发式到基于机器学习的自适应策略。通过建模决策者作为学习代理来调整策略参数。
AI.findings: 自适应决策感知评估策略减少了预测之间的性能差距，并在AI驱动决策环境中更准确地代表了预测价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个创新的自适应预测评估框架，将决策上下文纳入预测评估过程，理论上区分了预测质量和决策策略对绩效的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了更准确的预测价值评估方法，帮助决策者在实际应用中更好地选择和利用预测模型，特别是在金融、能源和运营管理等AI驱动决策环境中。

title: What drives the spatiotemporal evolution of land use conflicts? Evidence of threshold effects from 19 Chinese urban agglomerations
affiliations: Institute of Mountain Hazards and Environment Chinese Academy of Sciences, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: What drives the spatiotemporal evolution of land use conflicts? Evidence of threshold effects from 19 Chinese urban agglomerations
detail.abstract: Land use conflicts (LUCs) have emerged as a critical constraint on regional sustainable development. However, existing research predominantly focuses on single-dimensional conflict identification, lacking systematic comparative analysis and composite assessment at the urban agglomeration scale. This study employs multi-source data from 19 Chinese urban agglomerations spanning 2000–2020 to construct a land use assessment framework that integrates structural and functional conflicts. Utilizing spatial Durbin models, machine learning, and generalized additive models, it systematically reveals the spatiotemporal evolution patterns and driving mechanisms of LUCs. The findings indicate: (1) LUCs exhibited a phased pattern of 'initial rise followed by decline,' with significant intensification occurring between 2000 and 2010, gradually easing post-2010 alongside ecological civilization strategies; (2) Spatial patterns demonstrate an 'east-high, west-low' divergence, with core eastern agglomerations such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and the Yangtze River Delta Urban Agglomeration enduring persistent high conflict pressures, while northwestern regions experience lower conflict intensity; (3) The intensity of human footprint index (HFI) and terrain roughness index are dominant factors. Conflicts in eastern urban clusters primarily arise from high-intensity development pressures, whereas northwestern regions are constrained by topographical features. Key factors exhibit pronounced threshold effects: conflicts intensify sharply when HFI intensity and road network density exceed critical values. Vegetation cover demonstrates a non-monotonic influence, with the most acute contradictions between ecological conservation and development demands occurring in areas of moderate cover. This research provides scientific support for optimizing national spatial patterns, promoting coordinated regional development, and achieving dual carbon goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了整合结构与功能冲突的土地利用评估框架，系统分析了中国19个城市群2000-2020年土地利用冲突的时空演变模式和驱动机制，发现冲突呈现"先升后降"的阶段性特征，空间上"东高西低"，人类足迹指数和地形粗糙度是主导因素，关键因素存在明显阈值效应。
AI.research_question: 中国城市群尺度上土地利用冲突的时空演变模式是什么？其驱动机制如何？
AI.motivation: 土地利用冲突已成为区域可持续发展的关键制约因素，但现有研究主要关注单一维度的冲突识别，缺乏在城市群尺度上的系统比较分析和综合评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地利用冲突理论，整合了结构冲突和功能冲突的评估框架，空间经济学理论，生态-发展权衡理论。
AI.method: 使用2000-2020年中国19个城市群的多源数据，构建整合结构与功能冲突的土地利用评估框架，采用空间杜宾模型、机器学习和广义加性模型进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 1) 土地利用冲突呈现"先升后降"的阶段性模式，2000-2010年显著加剧，2010年后随生态文明战略逐渐缓解；2) 空间上呈现"东高西低"的分异格局，京津冀、长三角等东部核心城市群持续高压，西北地区冲突强度较低；3) 人类足迹指数和地形粗糙度是主导因素，关键因素存在明显阈值效应，植被覆盖度呈现非单调影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了整合结构与功能冲突的土地利用评估框架；2) 系统揭示了城市群尺度土地利用冲突的时空演变规律；3) 识别了关键驱动因素的阈值效应和非线性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为国家空间格局优化提供科学支持；2) 为促进区域协调发展提供决策依据；3) 为实现"双碳"目标提供政策参考；4) 为不同区域制定差异化土地利用管理策略提供指导。

title: Organizing Collective Action for Sufficiency in Community-Based Organizations: Cross-Cultural Patterns
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Organizing Collective Action for Sufficiency in Community-Based Organizations: Cross-Cultural Patterns
detail.abstract: Sufficiency is the culture and practice of “enoughness,” increasingly relevant in times of deepening social stratification and ecological degradation. Studying nineteen community-based organizations (CBOs) across land and food systems, energy and finance, housing and mobility, healthcare and education, intentional communities and governance systems, this paper asks: how do CBOs organize collective action so that it prioritizes meeting needs rather than generating ungeneralizable excess? Using a qualitative multiple-case design, it draws on semi-structured interviews with key representatives from each CBO and secondary sources, and analyzes them through abductive thematic coding. The results show that the featured CBOs face various social and ecological stressors, and in response they (1) organize collective action through the primacy of other-regarding intent centred on access to needs satisfiers, livelihood stability, and ecological stewardship; (2) cultivate autonomy, participation, and local control; (3) pool, share, and mutualize resources to provide safety nets and distribute risks; (4) develop community-based monitoring, co-created rules, and transparency that foster trust; and (5) invest in knowledge sharing and appropriate technologies that enhance capabilities. Together, these elements function as sufficiency-supporting microinstitutions—an “immune system” steering collective action to prioritize needs. Non-oligarchic, trust-based, autonomy-supportive arrangements of the studied CBOs offer instructions for organizing provisioning systems that secure basic needs within planetary boundaries.

title: When the Warrior Trembles: Mental Health Lessons from Arjuna & Krishna

detail.title: When the Warrior Trembles: Mental Health Lessons from Arjuna & Krishna
detail.abstract: Mental health is now recognized as central to human wellbeing across disciplines, yet the role of classical spiritual texts in addressing psychological distress remains underexplored. This paper examines the Bhagavad Gita as an early, profound framework for understanding mental health through the dialogue between the trembling warrior Arjuna and Sri Krishna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra. Arjuna’s paralysis, despair, and moral conflict closely parallel modern concepts of anxiety, depression, and moral injury—defined as psychological harm arising from actions that violate deeply held ethical values. Drawing upon interdisciplinary insights, including prior collaborative research with neurologists and psychiatrists published in the Journal of Religion and Health, this work situates the Gita as a holistic therapeutic text. It highlights how Krishna’s guidance integrates emotional validation, ethical clarity, and transformative action. The paper argues that healing emerges through sincerity, right action without attachment, and surrender, offering the Gita as a timeless reservoir of psychological resilience and moral restoration for contemporary life.

detail.abstract: Ditfurth and Arzt highlight the continuous, evolutionary process of general vehicle development from the horse-drawn carriage to the steam vehicle and eventually up to the internal combustion engine vehicle of today. Mutation and selection shaped this development to best meet customer needs. Technical, infrastructural and sociocultural requirements and needs are decisive. Thus, it was also a process of balancing different desires for human transportation and mobility culture: the vehicle as an urban, touring, racing, and luxury means of transport. Especially the transfer from the electric vehicle to the gasoline vehicle transformed the latter from a purely adventurous and speedy option to a more utilitarian mobility solution. Through the rising similarities in car features, price and the affordabilitysocioeconomic advantages of the gasoline car-became decisive prerequisites for the mass motorisation. In the 21st century the development of sustainable mobility solutions takes place between different drive systems. The acceptance of the public and the (potential) customers, as well as a sustainably value-creating business model for the OEMs and the customers, are prerequisites for the successful future of sustainable automotive mobility worldwide.

detail.abstract: In an era where AI-generated video and audio can convincingly imitate corporate leaders, the latency between misinformation and credible verification, Trust Velocity Gap (TVG) has collapsed to near zero. This paper argues that traditional crisis-response windows (e.g., 24 hours) are obsolete. Instead, a Zero-Hour mandate governs the trajectory of corporate reputational risk and stakeholder financial stability. We define the TVG, articulate a Zero Hour readiness framework, and propose metrics and governance mechanisms to protect long term value. Through theoretical framing and scenario analysis, the paper demonstrates that rapid, validated, pre-vetted communications within the first sixty minutes are determinative for investor confidence, employee trust, customer loyalty, and procurement stability.

detail.abstract: Digital twin technology originally developed in aerospace and manufacturing has rapidly emerged as a transformative paradigm in medicine. A medical digital twin is a dynamic, virtual representation of an individual patient that integrates biological, physiological, genetic, and environmental data to simulate health states and predict treatment outcomes. By enabling real-time monitoring, predictive modeling, and personalized intervention strategies, digital twins promise to revolutionize clinical decision-making and precision medicine. This paper explores the conceptual foundations of digital twins in medicine, their technological architecture, current clinical applications, and the ethical, regulatory, and technical challenges that must be addressed for large-scale adoption. The study concludes that digital twins represent a critical bridge between computational biology and personalized healthcare, with the potential to significantly improve patient outcomes, reduce healthcare costs, and shift medicine from reactive to predictive care.

detail.title: A Note on Information Disclosure in the Sharing Economy: An Operational Perspective
detail.abstract: This note examines how digital platforms in the sharing economy use information disclosure to shape user behavior, coordinate supply and demand, and manage operational performance. Drawing on examples from ride‑hailing, food delivery, freelance labor, and peer‑to‑peer markets, it synthesizes what platforms currently reveal in practice (such as wait‑time estimates, ratings, heatmaps, and demand forecasts) and connects these mechanisms to insights from operations management research. The discussion highlights key trade‑offs between transparency, control, efficiency, and trust, and outlines emerging challenges related to algorithmic personalization, cross‑market data sharing, and regulatory expectations. The note concludes by identifying promising directions for future Operations Management research on platform information disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了共享经济数字平台如何通过信息披露来塑造用户行为、协调供需和管理运营绩效，分析了当前实践中的信息披露机制及其与运营管理研究的联系，指出了透明度、控制、效率和信任之间的权衡，并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 数字平台如何通过信息披露来塑造用户行为、协调供需和管理运营绩效？
AI.motivation: 随着共享经济平台的快速发展，信息披露成为平台运营的关键工具，但现有研究对平台如何利用信息披露机制来协调市场参与者和优化运营绩效的系统性理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于运营管理理论，特别是信息经济学、平台经济学和行为运营管理理论，分析信息披露在协调供需、塑造行为和管理绩效中的作用。
AI.method: 采用多案例分析方法，综合考察网约车、外卖配送、自由职业和点对点市场等共享经济平台的实际信息披露实践，并与运营管理研究洞见进行连接。
AI.findings: 平台通过多种信息披露机制（如等待时间估计、评分系统、热力图和需求预测）来协调市场；这些机制在透明度、控制、效率和信任之间存在重要权衡；算法个性化、跨市场数据共享和监管期望带来了新的挑战。

AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了信息披露策略的实践指导，帮助理解不同信息披露机制的效果和权衡，为政策制定者提供了监管平台信息披露的参考依据。

title: The Commercialization Crisis In Advanced Biomedicine: Why

detail.title: The Commercialization Crisis In Advanced Biomedicine: Why

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced the work. No conflicts of interest exist.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding. The author received no financial support from any organization.

detail.abstract:
Despite unprecedented advances in biomedical science ranging from gene editing and cell therapies to precision oncology and RNA-based medicines many breakthrough therapies fail to reach patients at scale. This paradox reflects a growing commercialization crisis in advanced biomedicine, where scientific success does not reliably translate into clinical or societal impact. This article examines the structural, economic, regulatory, and institutional barriers that prevent promising biomedical innovations from progressing beyond the laboratory or early clinical trials. Drawing on evidence from translational research, health economics, and innovation studies, the paper argues that the crisis is not primarily scientific but systemic. It concludes by proposing policy and market-oriented reforms to realign incentives, de-risk late-stage translation, and ensure that biomedical breakthroughs fulfill their therapeutic potential.

Keywords: biomedical commercialization, translational medicine, innovation failure, health economics, regulatory science, advanced therapies

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了生物医学商业化危机：尽管生物医学科学取得了前所未有的进步（如基因编辑、细胞疗法、精准肿瘤学等），但许多突破性疗法无法大规模惠及患者。这种悖论反映了先进生物医学日益严重的商业化危机，科学成功未能可靠地转化为临床或社会影响。

AI.motivation: 生物医学科学取得了前所未有的进步，但许多突破性疗法无法大规模惠及患者，科学成功未能转化为临床或社会影响，形成了商业化危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于转化研究、卫生经济学和创新研究的证据，认为危机主要不是科学问题而是系统性问题。
AI.method: 文献综述和分析，基于转化研究、卫生经济学和创新研究的证据。
AI.findings: 生物医学商业化危机反映了结构性、经济性、监管性和制度性障碍，这些障碍阻止了有前景的创新从实验室或早期临床试验进一步推进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了生物医学商业化危机的系统性理论框架，强调问题不是科学失败而是系统失败。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了政策和市场导向的改革建议，以重新调整激励措施、降低后期转化风险，确保生物医学突破实现其治疗潜力。

title: The U.S. Space Force: Mediating Factors for Performance
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: The U.S. Space Force: Mediating Factors for Performance

detail.abstract:
There is currently little published literature because the Space Force is still in its preliminary stages, developing the elements that characterize an organization (Soto, 2023, p. 11). There are no quantitative performance studies; thus, the evidence is anecdotal. Currently, studies focus on technical integration rather than organizational or human integration. Many researchers believe that understanding the interdependent relationships among motivation, job performance, and job satisfaction is vital for addressing challenges and problems and is pertinent to organizations (Jalagat, 2016, pp. 36, 42).

This research applied the mediation models of Hayes (2022) to survey data from the 2024 Federal Employee Viewpoint Survey.  Six-factor scores were derived from the 2024 FEVS questions. They are Public Service Motivation, Employee Engagement, Commitment, Resilience, Job Satisfaction, Job Performance, and Leadership.  Factor scores are derived from survey items that assess an employee’s experience with the organization and its leaders. They are combined into a single factor score for interpretation and/or analysis.

The PROCESS macro by Hayes (2022) in IBM SPSS Statistics version 30.0 estimates coefficients in mediation models and provides modern inferential methods for indirect effects, including bootstrap confidence intervals. In an intervening-variable model, variable X is posited to affect an outcome variable Y via one or more intervening variables, also called mediators.

Four mediation models were applied in this research: the relationship between resilience and job performance was mediated by job satisfaction and work engagement; whether work-life balance mediates the relationship between leadership and job satisfaction; if satisfaction and engagement were statistically significant mediators of the relationship between resilience and job performance, and whether public service motivation was a statistically significant mediator of the relationship between work engagement and job performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2024年联邦雇员观点调查数据，通过Hayes的中介模型分析太空军组织中的工作动机、工作绩效和工作满意度之间的中介关系，填补了该新兴组织定量研究的空白。
AI.research_question: 在太空军组织中，工作满意度、工作投入、公共服务动机等因素如何中介影响韧性、领导力与工作绩效之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 太空军作为新兴组织，目前缺乏定量绩效研究，现有文献多为轶事证据，且研究重点偏向技术整合而非组织或人力整合。理解动机、工作绩效和工作满意度之间的相互依赖关系对解决组织挑战至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hayes(2022)的中介模型理论，探讨变量X通过中介变量影响结果变量Y的关系。研究涉及公共服务动机、员工投入、承诺、韧性、工作满意度、工作绩效和领导力等组织行为学理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2024年联邦雇员观点调查数据，从调查问题中提取六个因子得分。采用Hayes(2022)的PROCESS宏在IBM SPSS Statistics 30.0中运行四个中介模型，使用bootstrap置信区间进行间接效应推断。
AI.findings: 研究检验了四个中介模型：1)韧性通过工作满意度和工作投入影响工作绩效；2)工作生活平衡中介领导力与工作满意度的关系；3)满意度和投入是否显著中介韧性与绩效的关系；4)公共服务动机是否显著中介工作投入与绩效的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为太空军这一新兴组织的组织行为研究提供了首个定量分析框架，将中介模型应用于军事组织的绩效研究，拓展了组织行为理论在特殊军事环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为太空军管理者提供了基于实证的组织管理建议，帮助识别影响绩效的关键中介因素，为制定有效的人力资源政策和领导力发展策略提供数据支持。

title: Task Characteristics and Job Satisfaction: The Moderating Role of Automation
affiliations: University of Oslo - TIK-senteret, University of Pisa and University of Siena

detail.title: Task Characteristics and Job Satisfaction: The Moderating Role of Automation
detail.abstract: Recent research on automation and job satisfaction points out that robotization negatively impacts workers’ well-being by inducing fear ofreplacement, questioning work meaningfulness and/or affecting workers’ mental health. Seeking to consider both risks as well as potential benefitsof automation, the present paper focuses on the role of task characteristics for job satisfaction, and it investigates the moderating role of automation.Specifically, we consider three important task characteristics that vary across occupations - routine-manuality, perception and manipulation,and social intelligence - and we study how the effects of these characteristics on workers’ well-being are moderated by automation. The empiricalanalysis makes use of a rich database for the Italian labor market. The econometric results point out that robotization positively moderates theeffects of task characteristics on job satisfaction. Workers in occupations that have higher automatability risks are precisely those that experiencemore benefits from the introduction of machines in the workplace. This result holds for workers with lower education levels, and those that havea permanent job contract.

AI.tldr: 自动化对工作满意度的影响：研究发现机器人化正向调节任务特征对工作满意度的影响，自动化风险较高的职业从业者从工作场所引入机器中获益更多，特别是低教育水平和永久合同员工。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何调节任务特征对工作满意度的影响？具体来说，常规-手动性、感知与操作、社交智能这三个任务特征对员工福祉的影响如何受到自动化的调节？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注自动化对员工福祉的负面影响（如替代恐惧、工作意义质疑、心理健康影响），但缺乏对自动化潜在益处的考虑。本文旨在同时考虑自动化的风险和潜在好处，特别关注任务特征在自动化背景下对工作满意度的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务特征理论，重点关注三个跨职业变化的任务特征：常规-手动性、感知与操作、社交智能。结合自动化对工作满意度影响的理论框架，探讨自动化如何调节这些任务特征对员工福祉的影响。
AI.method: 使用意大利劳动力市场的丰富数据库进行实证分析，采用计量经济学方法研究自动化对任务特征与工作满意度关系的调节作用。
AI.findings: 机器人化正向调节任务特征对工作满意度的影响。自动化风险较高的职业从业者恰恰是从工作场所引入机器中获益更多的群体。这一结果对低教育水平员工和拥有永久工作合同的员工尤为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了自动化对工作满意度影响的理论视角，不仅考虑负面影响，也识别了潜在益处；2. 揭示了自动化风险与任务特征对工作满意度影响的交互作用机制；3. 为理解不同职业群体对自动化反应的异质性提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更全面的自动化影响评估框架；2. 帮助企业识别哪些员工群体可能从自动化中获益；3. 为职业培训和技能发展提供指导，特别是针对低教育水平员工；4. 为劳动力市场政策设计提供实证依据。

title: Report on Simplification of EU Financial Law
affiliations: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens - Faculty of Law, , Charles III University of Madrid, , Luxembourg Centre for European Law, University of Vienna - Faculty of Law, University of Edinburgh - School of Law, University of New South Wales (UNSW) - UNSW Law & Justice, University of St. Gallen (HSG), Leiden University, Centre for Commercial Law Studies, Queen Mary University of London, Frankfurt School of Finance and Management gGmbH, University of Vienna, Netanya Academic College, Israel, , University of Amsterdam, Ghent University - Financial Law Institute, University of Florence - Department of Economics and Management and Universite du Luxembourg - Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance

detail.title: Report on Simplification of EU Financial Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Banking Institute Working Paper Series No. 204
publicationDetails.journalName: European Banking Institute (EBI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This Report examines the systemic complexity of EU financial regulation and develops a structured and conceptually grounded framework for regulatory simplification. Covering banking, capital markets, insurance, and payments law, as well as selected cross-sectoral areas such as AML/CFT, digital finance, data governance, and sustainable finance, it argues that regulatory complexity in the EU has become cumulative and structural rather than incidental. Successive waves of legislation and supervision, driven by financial stability objectives, technological innovation, sustainability goals, and international standard-setting, have produced overlapping legal regimes, fragmented taxonomies, blurred institutional mandates, and an expanding reliance on highly technical and prescriptive rules.

The Report situates the simplification agenda within the broader EU policy context, including the Savings and Investments Union, recent institutional reports, and the European Commission’s simplification initiatives. It explicitly rejects any equation of simplification with deregulation, instead conceptualising simplification as a methodological and architectural exercise aimed at rationalising legal sources, stabilising definitions and taxonomies, and improving coherence across sectors and regulatory levels, with the objective of preserving substantive safeguards while enhancing clarity, accessibility, proportionality and effectiveness. Particular attention is devoted to institutional asymmetries across sectors, the erosion of the Lamfalussy framework, the hardening of soft law, and the interaction between EU and international regulatory standards.

On this basis, the Report advances a coherent set of policy proposals across institutional, substantive, and procedural dimensions. Institutionally, it calls for clearer mandates, legal status, and accountability of EU agencies, alongside a more balanced and coherent approach to supervisory centralisation beyond the banking sector. Substantively, it advocates restoring the hierarchy of regulatory sources envisaged by the Lamfalussy framework, refocusing Level-1 legislation on core principles, disciplining the use of Level-2 acts, and clarifying the legal effects of Level-3 soft law, combined with a systematic review and codification of definitions and taxonomies and a reduction of options and discretions where full harmonisation is feasible. Procedurally, it proposes a structured mapping of applicable rules across sectors and regulatory levels to identify overlaps and inconsistencies, complemented by coordinated reforms, regular evidence-based review cycles, and streamlined reporting through integrated systems and common data standards. It concludes that simplification is a prerequisite for the long-term effectiveness, legitimacy, and competitiveness of EU financial regulation, rather than an alternative to it.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了欧盟金融监管的系统性复杂性，提出了一个结构化的监管简化框架。报告认为欧盟监管复杂性已成为累积性和结构性问题，而非偶然现象，并提出在制度、实质和程序三个维度的政策建议，旨在通过简化提升监管的有效性、合法性和竞争力。
AI.research_question: 如何为欧盟金融监管的系统性复杂性开发一个结构化和概念化的简化框架？
AI.motivation: 欧盟金融监管在银行、资本市场、保险、支付等领域以及反洗钱、数字金融、可持续金融等跨领域呈现出累积性和结构性的复杂性，这影响了监管的有效性、清晰度和可及性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 报告基于Lamfalussy框架的监管层级理论，结合制度经济学和监管治理理论，分析监管复杂性的成因和影响。
AI.method: 采用政策分析和法律文本分析方法，对欧盟金融监管体系进行系统性评估，包括制度安排、法律渊源、定义分类等方面的分析。
AI.findings: 欧盟金融监管复杂性源于多轮立法和监督浪潮，导致法律体系重叠、分类法碎片化、机构职责模糊，以及过度依赖技术性和规定性规则。Lamfalussy框架受到侵蚀，软法硬化现象明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监管简化作为方法论和架构性实践的理论框架，区分了简化与放松监管的概念，为监管复杂性研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了制度、实质和程序三个维度的具体政策建议：明确欧盟机构职责、恢复Lamfalussy框架的监管层级、系统审查和编纂定义分类、建立结构化规则映射和协调改革机制等。

title: The Dollar's Double Life: Not All Dollar Appreciations are Born Equal for the Cross-Currency Basis
affiliations: University of Essex - Department of Mathematics, Baum Tenpers Research Institute and Asian Institute of Management

detail.title: The Dollar's Double Life: Not All Dollar Appreciations are Born Equal for the Cross-Currency Basis

keywords: Dollar Appreciation Hedging Demand and Supply

detail.abstract: This paper revisits the relationship between the US dollar and cross-currency basis swap spreads. We show that the strength and direction of this relationship depend on the prevailing regime of the broad dollar. The evidence suggests that the well-documented "dollar appreciates, basis widens" result holds primarily when the dollar is in a low or intermediate regime. However, Once the dollar transitions into a high regime, this association either weakens or reverses: a stronger dollar no longer widens the basis, and may tighten it. Our findings reveal that not all dollar appreciations are created equal. For the same magnitude of dollar appreciation, basis spreads tend to widen significantly more in low-or intermediate-dollar regimes than in high-dollar regime. We explain these results through a theoretical framework grounded in hedging demand and supply imbalances and validate them empirically using the term structure of cross-currency basis swap spreads of G10 currencies.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视美元与跨货币基差互换利差的关系，发现这种关系的强度和方向取决于美元所处的制度区间。传统"美元升值、基差扩大"的现象主要在美元处于低或中等区间时成立，一旦美元进入高区间，这种关联会减弱甚至反转。
AI.research_question: 美元与跨货币基差互换利差之间的关系如何随美元制度区间的变化而变化？
AI.motivation: 传统研究普遍认为美元升值会导致跨货币基差互换利差扩大，但本文发现这种关系并非一成不变，需要更细致地考察美元所处的制度区间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对冲需求和供给失衡的理论框架，解释不同美元制度区间下美元与基差互换利差关系的差异。
AI.method: 使用G10货币的跨货币基差互换利差期限结构进行实证验证，分析不同美元制度区间下的关系变化。
AI.findings: 1. "美元升值、基差扩大"的现象主要在美元低或中等区间成立；2. 美元进入高区间后，这种关联减弱甚至反转；3. 相同幅度的美元升值，在低/中等区间比在高区间导致更大的基差扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于美元制度区间的非线性关系理论，挑战了传统的线性假设，深化了对美元与跨货币基差互换利差关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和金融机构提供了更精确的风险管理工具，帮助他们根据美元所处的不同制度区间调整对冲策略和投资决策。

title: The Economic Consequences of Regulatory Failure: Evidence from the 2017 KPMG-PCAOB Audit Inspection Scandal
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business, National University of Singapore (NUS), National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN) and National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School

detail.title: The Economic Consequences of Regulatory Failure: Evidence from the 2017 KPMG-PCAOB Audit Inspection Scandal
detail.abstract: We study the 2017 KPMG-PCAOB audit inspection scandal, an extreme case of revolving door gone wrong with the potential to compromise the integrity of U.S. audit supervision, and examine how this detected regulatory failure affects client banks that are uninvolved in the misconduct but named in court transcripts. Using a difference-indifferences design, we find that treatment banks significantly reduce mortgage credit supply following the scandal, originating about 969 fewer mortgages per bank-year on average, which corresponds to an approximate $138 million reduction in annual mortgage credit. These adjustments are concentrated among banks under greater ex ante scrutiny from banking regulators, the Securities and Exchange Commission, and the Consumer Finance Protection Bureau. Treatment banks also improve mortgage service quality following the scandal. Ex post, these banks strengthen their capital buffers and experience fewer enforcement actions. Overall, our findings suggest that extreme regulatory failures can have real economic consequences beyond directly regulated entities, prompting client banks in our setting to reallocate resources away from expanding credit volume toward improving service quality under intensified regulatory oversight.

AI.tldr: 研究2017年KPMG-PCAOB审计检查丑闻这一极端监管失败案例，发现即使未直接参与不当行为的客户银行也会显著减少抵押贷款供应（平均每家银行每年减少969笔贷款，约1.38亿美元），同时提高服务质量，加强资本缓冲，减少监管处罚
AI.research_question: 已发现的监管失败如何影响未参与不当行为但被法庭记录提及的客户银行？
AI.motivation: 研究极端监管失败案例（"旋转门"问题）对审计监管完整性的潜在损害，以及这种监管失败如何影响未直接参与不当行为的客户银行
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管失败理论、旋转门问题、监管溢出效应、银行信贷行为理论
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计（difference-in-differences），比较处理组银行（被法庭记录提及但未参与不当行为）与控制组银行在丑闻前后的变化
AI.findings: 处理组银行在丑闻后显著减少抵押贷款供应（平均每家银行每年减少969笔，约1.38亿美元），主要集中在受银行监管机构、SEC和CFPB事前审查更严格的银行；同时提高抵押服务质量，加强资本缓冲，减少监管处罚
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了监管失败溢出效应的理论，表明极端监管失败对未直接参与不当行为的实体也有显著经济影响；深化了对银行在监管压力下资源重新配置行为的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供警示：监管失败的影响可能超出直接监管对象；为银行管理者提供应对监管风险的策略参考；为政策制定者完善监管体系提供实证依据

title: The Impact of Multi-acquiring in the Payment System: Evidence from Uruguayan Financial Inclusion Program
affiliations: Universidad ORT Uruguay and Universidad ORT at Uruguay

detail.title: The Impact of Multi-acquiring in the Payment System: Evidence from Uruguayan Financial Inclusion Program

publicationDetails.journalName: Inter-American Development Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the transition from exclusive card network-acquirer relationships to a multi-acquiring model. Using the case of Uruguay’s adoption of multi-acquiring in 2022, as part of a broader financial inclusion program. We document significant market dynamics, including restructured relationships among incumbents and new market entrants. Our analysis, leveraging the Herfindahl- Hirschman Index, reveals decreased market concentration across all payment segments. While fee reductions were initially driven by a government-sponsored price agreement, the increased competition fostered by multi-acquiring stabilized these rates even after the agreement was no longer in effect. Large merchants benefited from enhanced efficiency, but small merchants faced adaptation challenges. These findings underscore the complexities of regulating two-sided payment markets and emphasize the need for balanced interventions to ensure a competitive payment ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了乌拉圭从独家卡网络-收单机构关系向多收单模式的转变，发现市场集中度下降、费率降低但小商户面临适应挑战，强调了平衡监管的重要性。
AI.research_question: 从独家卡网络-收单机构关系向多收单模式转变对支付市场动态、竞争结构和商户福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究多收单模式作为金融包容计划的一部分，如何影响支付市场的竞争结构、费率动态和不同规模商户的适应情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边市场理论、市场集中度理论（赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数）、竞争政策理论、金融包容理论。
AI.method: 案例研究（乌拉圭2022年多收单模式实施），使用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数分析市场集中度变化，结合定性分析市场动态。
AI.findings: 1) 市场集中度在所有支付细分领域下降；2) 费率最初由政府价格协议驱动降低，但多收单带来的竞争使费率在协议结束后保持稳定；3) 大型商户效率提升，小型商户面临适应挑战；4) 市场关系重组，新进入者出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 深化了对双边支付市场监管复杂性的理解；2) 为多收单模式对市场结构和竞争的影响提供实证证据；3) 拓展了金融包容政策与市场竞争互动的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供平衡监管干预的参考；2) 帮助商户了解不同规模下的适应策略；3) 为支付行业参与者提供市场竞争动态的洞察。

title: Connectivity and Misallocation in Multi-unit Firms
affiliations: Georgetown University, Inter-American Development Bank and

detail.title: Connectivity and Misallocation in Multi-unit Firms

publicationDetails.journalName: Inter-American Development Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the causal effect of reducing distance-related frictions with headquarters on branch outcomes in multi-unit firms in B razil. Exploiting the introduction of new airline routes, we compare branches that gain a direct flight t o t heir headquarters with otherwise similar branches in the same location that do not. In contrast to prior findings from high-income country settings, improved connectivity with headquarters lowers 12-month survival and, conditional on survival, reduces service and production employment. To interpret these results, we develop a model with three distancedependent frictions: i) internal coordination costs of delivering headquarters inputs to branches; ii) client-service costs when serving markets without a local branch; and iii) a moral-hazard friction whereby distance amplifies l ocal m anagers’ incentives to over-hire. Consistent with the model’s predictions, survival declines are larger at closer branches, while employment reductions are concentrated at more distant branches and in firms with lower headquarters b andwidth. The model clarifies how the impact of reduced frictions with headquarters depends on pre-existing distortions and reconciles heterogeneous connectivity effects observed across developing- and high-income contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴西多单元企业中，减少与总部距离摩擦对分支机构结果的影响。利用新航线开通的自然实验发现，与高收入国家不同，改善与总部的连通性降低了分支机构12个月生存率，并减少了服务和生产就业。作者建立了一个包含三种距离依赖摩擦的理论模型来解释这些异质性结果。
AI.research_question: 减少与总部的距离摩擦对多单元企业分支机构的结果（生存率和就业）有何因果影响？这种影响在发展中国家背景下与高收入国家有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注高收入国家背景下的总部-分支机构关系，但发展中国家可能存在不同的制度环境和市场条件。理解距离摩擦在不同经济环境下的异质性影响对于企业战略和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 作者构建了一个包含三种距离依赖摩擦的理论模型：1) 向分支机构提供总部投入的内部协调成本；2) 在没有本地分支机构的市场中服务客户的成本；3) 道德风险摩擦（距离放大本地经理过度雇佣的动机）。
AI.method: 利用巴西新航线开通作为自然实验，采用准实验设计比较获得直飞总部分支机构与同一地点未获得直飞总部分支机构的结果差异。
AI.findings: 1) 改善与总部的连通性降低了分支机构12个月生存率；2) 在存活的分支机构中，减少了服务和生产就业；3) 生存率下降在距离较近的分支机构中更明显；4) 就业减少集中在距离较远的分支机构和总部带宽较低的企业中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了一个包含三种距离依赖摩擦的理论框架；2) 解释了减少总部摩擦的影响如何取决于预先存在的扭曲；3) 调和了发展中国家和高收入国家背景下观察到的异质性连通性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为发展中国家多单元企业的扩张和分支机构管理提供战略启示；2) 揭示了改善交通基础设施可能产生的意外后果；3) 为企业总部带宽管理和距离相关的道德风险控制提供实践指导。

title: Are All Prior Art References Becoming Analogous in the AI Age?
affiliations: Berkeley Centre for Law and Technology

detail.title: Are All Prior Art References Becoming Analogous in the AI Age?
detail.abstract:
This Article focuses on an important doctrinal question: Are all prior art references becoming “analogous” in the AI age? While this question may seem trivial at first glance, it is one of the key inquiries that would significantly shape the specific contour of patent law in an age with super-efficient machines.

As state-of-the-art (SOTA) artificial intelligence is integrated into research and development, a new inventing paradigm is taking shape: Centaur (Human + AI) Inventing Synergy. In this paradigm, a cognitive division of labor has formed between human researchers and AI. While AI possesses unprecedented “horsepower” for solving problems, it remains inherently limited in creative problem defining—the stronghold of human faculty for finding and framing original problems in complex, real-world contexts.

This paradigm shift poses systemic challenges to patent law. Building on previous work regarding the rise of Centaur Inventors, this Article focuses on the US Patent Act Section 103 non-obviousness doctrine. Under the Graham-KSR framework, whether a claimed invention is adequately creative is a legal question based on the scope and content of prior art and the skill level of a person having ordinary skill in the art (PHOSITA). Unlike the Section 102 novelty doctrine, U.S. patent law imposes a filter for Section 103: for a prior art reference to be considered, it must first be found "analogous" to the claimed invention.

Under Federal Circuit precedent, a reference is analogous if it is from the same field of endeavor or is "reasonably pertinent to the particular problem with which the inventor is involved." This requirement recognizes that a PHOSITA cannot be aware of every field and serves as a vital safeguard against potential hindsight bias. Following the Supreme Court's decision in KSR v. Teleflex, the analogous art inquiry has become the primary doctrinal firewall against an overbroad determination of obviousness. 

Despite its post-KSR strategic primacy, the methodology remains vague. A careful reading of Federal Circuit case law reveals a persistent doctrinal void: the Court frequently defaults to the inventor’s own subjective, ex post problem statement—often drawn from the patent specification—rather than independently reconstructing how a PHOSITA would have framed the problem ex ante.

In the AI age, this "specification trap" risks rendering all prior art analogous. As illustrated by thought experiments involving the Wright brothers’ 3D dynamic control and origami-inspired surgical tools, once a human achieves the creative leap of framing a "catalytic problem," AI’s boundless connectivity can retrospectively bridge disparate fields, making the resulting solution appear inevitable. This Article illustrates how an unexamined analogous art doctrine systematically penalizes the most creative human leaps.

To preserve the incentive for human "architects" of invention, this Article proposes a rigorous adherence to the Federal Circuit’s teaching in Donner v. Pro Stage (2020). Notably, although the Donner decision was not originally intended to address AI-related challenges, its mandate provides a vital corrective for the current era. By requiring that the "problem to be solved" be identified from the objective, ex ante perspective of the PHOSITA, the Donner guardrail prevents the infinite interpolation of AI from collapsing distinct fields into a single pool of analogous art. Ultimately, patent law must evolve to properly value and protect the crucial human sparkle: the act of creative problem-defining.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在AI时代，所有现有技术是否都变得"类似"的问题。随着AI在研发中的整合，形成了"半人马（人类+AI）发明协同"的新范式，这对专利法第103条非显而易见性条款中的"类似技术"判断标准构成系统性挑战。文章提出应严格遵循Donner v. Pro Stage案确立的客观标准，从本领域普通技术人员的角度识别"待解决问题"，以保护人类创造性问题定义的核心价值。
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，所有现有技术是否都变得"类似"？这如何影响专利法第103条非显而易见性条款中的"类似技术"判断标准？
AI.motivation: 随着最先进AI技术融入研发，形成了"半人马（人类+AI）发明协同"的新范式。AI拥有前所未有的问题解决能力，但在创造性问题定义方面存在固有局限。这种范式转变对专利法构成系统性挑战，特别是对非显而易见性条款中的"类似技术"判断标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国专利法第103条非显而易见性条款的Graham-KSR框架，以及联邦巡回上诉法院关于"类似技术"的判例法，特别是Donner v. Pro Stage (2020)案的判决。
AI.method: 采用法律分析方法，包括：1）分析联邦巡回上诉法院判例中关于"类似技术"判断的司法实践；2）通过思想实验（如莱特兄弟的3D动态控制和折纸启发的手术工具）说明AI时代的问题；3）提出基于Donner案判决的解决方案。
AI.findings: 1）当前司法实践中存在"说明书陷阱"：法院经常默认发明人主观的、事后的问题陈述，而不是独立重构本领域普通技术人员事前会如何界定问题；2）在AI时代，这种陷阱可能导致所有现有技术都被视为类似技术；3）一旦人类完成创造性问题定义的飞跃，AI的无边界连接能力可以追溯性地桥接不同领域，使解决方案看起来不可避免。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）识别了AI时代专利法中"类似技术"判断标准的系统性缺陷；2）阐明了"说明书陷阱"如何惩罚最具创造性的人类飞跃；3）提出了基于Donner v. Pro Stage案判决的理论框架，强调应从本领域普通技术人员的客观、事前角度识别"待解决问题"。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为专利审查员和法院提供了具体的操作指南，以避免"说明书陷阱"；2）保护人类发明"架构师"的激励，确保专利法继续重视和保护创造性问题定义这一关键人类能力；3）为专利法适应AI时代提供了具体的司法实践建议。

title: Social Preferences for Public Provision of Services: Experimental Evidence from Latin America
affiliations: Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas (CIDE) - Center for Research and Teaching of Economics (CIDE), Students, Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and Inter-American Development Bank

detail.title: Social Preferences for Public Provision of Services: Experimental Evidence from Latin America

publicationDetails.journalName: Inter-American Development Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how individuals in six Latin American countries value public versus private provision of education and healthcare using a survey experiment. Respondents were randomly assigned to vignettes that vary income, service quality, and provider type. Perceived quality is the main driver of choices: the probability of selecting a private provider roughly doubles when public quality falls from 80 to 20 percent, while income has a smaller effect. Higher institutional trust lowers the likelihood of switching to private providers but does not affect willingness to pay once individuals choose private provision. The multi-country design supports external validity and reveals similar behavioral responses across contexts. The results show that improving service quality and rebuilding institutional trust can reduce reliance on private provision.

AI.tldr: 通过六个拉美国家的调查实验，研究发现服务质量是选择公私教育医疗的主要驱动因素，收入影响较小；制度信任降低转向私营的概率但不影响支付意愿；改善服务质量和重建制度信任可减少对私营的依赖。
AI.research_question: 拉美国家个体如何评价教育医疗的公私提供？服务质量、收入水平和制度信任如何影响选择？
AI.motivation: 理解拉美国家民众对公私教育医疗提供方式的偏好，为政策制定提供实证依据，探讨如何减少对私营部门的过度依赖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和制度信任理论，分析个体在公共服务选择中的决策机制，探讨质量感知、收入约束和制度信任的交互作用。
AI.method: 在六个拉美国家进行随机对照调查实验，通过情景模拟(vignettes)随机分配收入、服务质量和提供者类型变量，收集个体选择数据并进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 1) 感知质量是主要驱动因素：公共质量从80%降至20%时，选择私营的概率约翻倍；2) 收入影响较小；3) 制度信任降低转向私营的概率，但不影响选择私营后的支付意愿；4) 多国设计支持外部有效性，行为反应相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了质量感知在公共服务选择中的核心作用；2) 揭示了制度信任对选择概率和支付意愿的不同影响机制；3) 为跨文化背景下的公共服务偏好研究提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供实证依据：改善公共服务质量和重建制度信任可减少对私营部门的依赖；2) 多国比较为区域政策协调提供参考；3) 方法学上展示了调查实验在公共服务研究中的应用价值。

title: Component-wise Latent Class Choice Model
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

detail.title: Component-wise Latent Class Choice Model
detail.abstract:
Understanding individual preference heterogeneity is a central challenge in discrete choice modeling. While the Latent Class Choice Model (LCCM) offers interpretable segmentation by grouping individuals with similar tastes, it imposes a restrictive structure in which all utility coefficients vary jointly within a single latent class. When heterogeneity arises independently across multiple attribute dimensions, this structure requires a combinatorial number of classes, leading to parameter redundancy, information dispersion, and statistical inefficiency.


To address these limitations, we propose the Component-wise Latent Class Choice Model (CLCCM). The CLCCM decomposes the utility function into analyst-defined components, each governed by its own latent class structure. Rather than assigning individuals to a single monolithic class, the model allows distinct class memberships for each utility component, with overall preference profiles formed as the Cartesian product of component-specific memberships. This structure parsimoniously captures multidimensional heterogeneity while preserving interpretability. We further develop a generalized EM algorithm with component-wise updates that guarantees monotonic likelihood improvement and stable estimation.


Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the CLCCM achieves superior statistical efficiency, more accurate recovery of utility coefficients and memberships, and more stable convergence than conventional LCCM specifications spanning the same heterogeneity space. An empirical application to discrete choice experiment data on breast cancer screening shows that the CLCCM uncovers interpretable behavioral segments associated with specific parts of the utility function that are conflated in standard models. Overall, the CLCCM provides a flexible and scalable framework that balances interpretability and efficiency for modeling multidimensional preference heterogeneity in applied choice analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了组件化潜在类别选择模型（CLCCM），通过将效用函数分解为分析师定义的组件，每个组件有自己的潜在类别结构，从而更高效地捕捉多维偏好异质性，解决了传统潜在类别选择模型在多个属性维度上异质性独立出现时的组合爆炸问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既能保持可解释性又能高效捕捉多维偏好异质性的离散选择模型？
AI.motivation: 传统潜在类别选择模型（LCCM）将所有效用系数限制在单个潜在类别内共同变化，当异质性在多个属性维度上独立出现时，需要组合数量的类别，导致参数冗余、信息分散和统计效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择建模理论，特别是潜在类别选择模型框架，但通过组件化分解方法扩展了传统模型的结构。
AI.method: 提出了组件化潜在类别选择模型（CLCCM），将效用函数分解为分析师定义的组件，每个组件有自己的潜在类别结构；开发了具有组件化更新的广义EM算法，保证单调似然改进和稳定估计；通过蒙特卡洛模拟和乳腺癌筛查离散选择实验数据进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 蒙特卡洛模拟显示CLCCM比传统LCCM具有更优的统计效率、更准确的效用系数和成员恢复、更稳定的收敛性；实证应用显示CLCCM能发现与效用函数特定部分相关的可解释行为细分，这些在标准模型中会被混淆。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了组件化潜在类别选择模型的理论框架，通过笛卡尔积方式组合组件特定成员关系形成整体偏好轮廓，平衡了可解释性和效率；开发了保证单调似然改进的广义EM算法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应用选择分析提供了灵活可扩展的框架，能更有效地建模多维偏好异质性；在乳腺癌筛查选择实验中展示了实际应用价值，能发现传统模型无法识别的行为细分。

title: Strategic Interactions and Gender Cues: Evidence from Social Preference Games
affiliations: Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas (CIDE) - Center for Research and Teaching of Economics (CIDE), Students, Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and Inter-American Development Bank

detail.title: Strategic Interactions and Gender Cues: Evidence from Social Preference Games

publicationDetails.journalName: Inter-American Development Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies trust, reciprocity, and bargaining using a large-scale online experi- ment conducted in six Latin American countries. Participants played trust and ultima- tum games under randomly assigned conditions in which the gender of their counterpart was either disclosed or withheld. On average, disclosing counterpart gender does not yield statistically detectable eects in either game. However, statistically signi cant dierences emerge by participants' own gender: on average men exhibit higher levels of trust, reciprocity, and generosity in bargaining than women. When disaggregating by participant{counterpart gender pairings, point estimates dier in sign across groups but are generally imprecisely estimated, and dierences between interacting with male versus female counterparts are generally not statistically distinguishable. Overall, the results are consistent with limited behavioral responses to counterpart gender when gender is conveyed through minimal, text-based cues, notwithstanding clear average gender dierences.

AI.tldr: 本文通过六个拉美国家的大规模在线实验，研究了信任、互惠和议价行为。研究发现：披露对方性别对行为没有显著影响，但参与者自身性别存在显著差异——男性比女性表现出更高的信任、互惠和议价慷慨度。不同性别组合的配对分析显示点估计存在差异但不显著，总体上表明通过文本线索传达性别信息对行为影响有限。
AI.research_question: 在信任游戏和最后通牒游戏中，披露对方性别信息是否会影响参与者的信任、互惠和议价行为？参与者自身性别与对方性别的交互如何影响这些行为？
AI.motivation: 性别在经济学实验中的影响一直是研究热点，但现有研究结果不一致，且多数基于实验室环境。本研究旨在通过大规模在线实验，在更自然的环境中探究性别信息对信任、互惠和议价行为的影响，特别是在拉美国家的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学理论，特别是信任游戏和最后通牒游戏的理论框架。信任游戏用于测量信任和互惠行为，最后通牒游戏用于测量议价行为和公平偏好。性别差异理论认为男性和女性在风险偏好、社会偏好和策略行为上存在系统性差异。
AI.method: 在六个拉美国家进行大规模在线实验，参与者随机分配到不同条件：对方性别信息被披露或隐瞒。使用信任游戏测量信任（投资额）和互惠（回报额），使用最后通牒游戏测量议价慷慨度（提议分配比例）。采用随机对照实验设计，进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 1. 披露对方性别信息对信任、互惠和议价行为没有统计上可检测的影响；2. 参与者自身性别存在显著差异：男性比女性表现出更高的信任、互惠和议价慷慨度；3. 不同性别组合的配对分析显示点估计存在差异但不显著；4. 与男性或女性对手互动时的行为差异通常不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了性别信息对经济决策具有重要影响的假设；2. 表明通过简单文本线索传达的性别信息可能不足以引发显著行为变化；3. 证实了性别差异的存在，但强调了这些差异主要来自参与者自身性别而非对方性别信息；4. 为性别与行为经济学理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为在线平台设计提供了参考：简单的性别披露可能不会显著影响用户行为；2. 对组织管理和谈判实践有启示：应关注参与者自身性别差异而非过度关注对方性别信息；3. 为跨文化研究提供了拉美国家的实证数据；4. 为政策制定者提供了关于性别平等干预措施有效性的参考。

title: Strategic Leadership in AI-Enhanced Aviation: Balancing Financial and Environmental Goals through Differentiated Search
affiliations: University of Religions and Denominations and Islamic Azad University

detail.title: Strategic Leadership in AI-Enhanced Aviation: Balancing Financial and Environmental Goals through Differentiated Search
detail.abstract: This study examines how strategic leadership styles shape the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in airline operations, highlighting both financial performance and sustainability outcomes. A mixed-method design was employed, combining semi-structured interviews, archival operational reports, and document analyses of AI initiatives. Central to this research are multi-objective optimization algorithms including evolutionary computing and reinforcement learning that simultaneously improve cost-effectiveness and reduce environmental impacts. The findings show that transformational leadership fosters broad AI adoption, notably in areas like predictive maintenance and emission reduction, whereas transactional leadership tends to emphasize short-term efficiency gains. Quantitatively, evolutionary algorithms and reinforcement learning consistently produce cost reductions of 7-12% while yielding fuel savings of 6-10%, underscoring their potential to balance profitability with ecological responsibility. From a theoretical standpoint, these insights enrich leadership and digital transformation frameworks by illustrating how executive behaviors and complex AI technologies interact to achieve dual financial and environmental benefits. In practical terms, the study recommends forming cross-functional governance committees, enhancing leadership training to encourage visionary communication, and adopting phased AI deployments to manage elevated risk tolerance. To operationalize these findings, Appendix A provides a set of role-based Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for financial performance and sustainability, offering practitioners a clear metric framework for measuring progress. Overall, this research underscores the need to align AI-driven analytics with strategic leadership competencies and robust oversight mechanisms, presenting a roadmap to optimize costs, meet sustainability targets, and ensure resilient decision-making in the ever-evolving aviation sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨战略领导风格如何影响航空公司AI整合，发现变革型领导促进广泛AI应用（如预测性维护和减排），而交易型领导侧重短期效率。多目标优化算法（进化计算和强化学习）能同时实现7-12%成本降低和6-10%燃油节约，平衡盈利与环保。
AI.research_question: 战略领导风格如何塑造航空公司人工智能整合，并影响财务绩效和可持续发展成果？
AI.motivation: 航空业面临平衡成本效益与环境责任的挑战，需要理解领导风格与复杂AI技术如何相互作用以实现双重目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导理论（变革型领导与交易型领导）、数字转型框架、多目标优化理论。
AI.method: 混合方法设计：结合半结构化访谈、档案运营报告和AI项目文件分析，重点关注进化计算和强化学习等多目标优化算法。
AI.findings: 变革型领导促进广泛的AI采用（如预测性维护和减排），交易型领导强调短期效率；进化算法和强化学习实现7-12%成本降低和6-10%燃油节约。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富领导和数字转型框架，展示高管行为与复杂AI技术如何相互作用以实现财务和环境双重效益。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议组建跨职能治理委员会、加强领导力培训以鼓励愿景沟通、采用分阶段AI部署管理风险；附录A提供基于角色的财务和可持续发展KPI框架。

title: Integration of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Diagnostic Healthcare
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Integration of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Diagnostic Healthcare

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: The immediate adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) into diagnostic healthcare has become an urgent solution to the longstanding global malabsorption of diagnostic accuracy, timeliness, and resource decisions, especially in strained health systems (Panesar, 2019; Ahmed et al., 2020). This research paper conducts a critical and systematic review of multidisciplinary sources encompassing clinical medicine, data science, health policy, and ethics in order to evaluate the potential and drawbacks of AI-powered diagnostic tools in terms of transformative power. Based on empirical, as well as conceptual evidence, the review establishes the gains in diagnostic accuracy, early disease diagnosis, and clinical decision support, and significant improvement has been shown across imaging, pathology, and predictive analytics (Undru et al., 2022; Mahalingam et al., 2024). Besides performance improvement, AI and MLs are also shown to have considerable workflow efficiencies in the sense that they minimize the burden on clinicians, facilitate real-time risk stratification, and facilitate individualized diagnostic pathways depending on patient profiles. Nevertheless, the synthesis also shows that there are still significant issues that inhibit massive and fair implementation, such as data bias, less explain ability, infrastructural differences, regulatory fragmentation, and ethical questions of accountability and patient trust. The main finding of the research is that AI and ML can significantly improve the diagnostic potential; however, their further usefulness is subject to responsible and human-centered integration that can synchronize technological advancement with clinical practice, ethical regulation of AI, and the design of health systems to be inclusive (Kudina and de Boer, 2021). These limitations need to be mitigated to make sure that AI-enabled diagnostics make a valuable contribution to health equity and system resilience across the globe.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统综述评估AI/ML在医疗诊断中的潜力与局限，发现AI能显著提升诊断准确性、早期发现和临床决策支持，但面临数据偏见、可解释性不足、基础设施差异等挑战，需要负责任、以人为本的整合才能实现其价值。
AI.research_question: AI和机器学习在医疗诊断中的潜力与局限性是什么？如何评估AI驱动诊断工具的变革能力？
AI.motivation: 全球医疗系统长期面临诊断准确性、及时性和资源分配不足的问题，AI/ML的快速采用成为解决这些问题的迫切方案，特别是在资源紧张的医疗系统中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合临床医学、数据科学、卫生政策和伦理学等多学科理论框架，评估AI诊断工具的变革潜力。
AI.method: 采用批判性和系统性文献综述方法，综合分析实证和概念性证据，涵盖影像学、病理学和预测分析等领域。
AI.findings: AI/ML能显著提高诊断准确性、早期疾病诊断和临床决策支持，改善工作流程效率，减轻临床医生负担，实现实时风险分层和个性化诊断路径。但存在数据偏见、可解释性不足、基础设施差异、监管碎片化以及问责和患者信任等伦理问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了评估AI诊断工具变革潜力的多学科理论框架，提出了负责任、以人为本的AI整合理论，强调技术发展需要与临床实践、伦理监管和包容性卫生系统设计同步。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗系统实施AI诊断工具提供了实践指导，指出了需要解决的关键障碍，提出了促进健康公平和系统韧性的具体建议，帮助决策者制定更有效的AI整合策略。

title: Shadow P&L: Integrating Jungian Archetypes, Corporate Finance, and Gamification for Organizational Health

detail.title: Shadow P&L: Integrating Jungian Archetypes, Corporate Finance, and Gamification for Organizational Health
detail.abstract:
This working paper introduces the "Shadow P&L" framework—a novel diagnostic methodology that maps specific profit-and-loss line items to psychological shadow archetypes of company founders, particularly for mid-sized businesses ($30-50M revenue) navigating the critical "valley of death" growth phase.

Traditional financial analysis treats P&L anomalies (high CAC, bloated payroll, excessive R&D) as isolated operational failures requiring technical fixes. We propose that these financial pathologies are behavioral artifacts—crystallized manifestations of founders' unintegrated psychological patterns. Drawing on Jungian psychology, we identify four shadow archetypes: (1) The Hero's Shadow (Martyr/Bully) driving CAC inflation and high customer churn; (2) The Caregiver's Shadow (Enabler) creating payroll bloat and low revenue-per-employee; (3) The Creator's Shadow (Perfectionist) causing endless R&D cycles and feature creep; (4) The Ruler's Shadow (Tyrant) inflating administrative costs through micromanagement.

We validate this framework through cross-analysis of 100+ academic studies (including PNAS research showing founder personality predicts startup success 5x better than industry sector) and real-world case studies (Casper's CAC crisis, Apple's 11-year perfectionism stagnation, Tesla's 17-year burn rate). Our evidence demonstrates quantifiable correlations: narcissistic CEOs increase bankruptcy risk by 23%; perfectionism reduces growth rates by 23%; 15% payroll inefficiency eliminates net profit entirely.

The paper's distinctive contribution lies in prescribing "Gamification-as-Therapy"—twelve behavioral design interventions that redirect founders' shadow impulses into constructive organizational mechanics. These include: Client Tamagotchi (transforming Hero's conquest addiction into retention focus), Lifeboat Wargaming (training Caregiver's resource triage), Feature Tax (visualizing Creator's opportunity cost), and Autonomy Tree (delegating Ruler's control through leveling systems).

This framework offers practitioners a psychometric lens for P&L diagnostics, moving beyond spreadsheet optimization to address the root behavioral drivers of financial dysfunction. It also contributes to entrepreneurship research by operationalizing Jungian archetypes within corporate finance contexts—a previously unexplored interdisciplinary synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"影子损益"框架，将公司损益表中的具体项目与创始人心理阴影原型对应，认为财务异常是创始人未整合心理模式的行为产物，而非单纯运营问题。通过100+学术研究和案例验证，并设计了12种"游戏化治疗"干预措施来转化阴影冲动。
AI.research_question: 创始人心理阴影原型如何具体影响中型企业（3000-5000万美元营收）在"死亡谷"增长阶段的损益表异常？
AI.motivation: 传统财务分析将损益表异常（高获客成本、人员臃肿、过度研发）视为需要技术修复的孤立运营失败，但本文认为这些财务病理是创始人未整合心理模式的行为产物，需要从心理学角度解决根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 荣格心理学阴影原型理论：英雄阴影（殉道者/霸凌者）、照顾者阴影（纵容者）、创造者阴影（完美主义者）、统治者阴影（暴君）。这些原型分别对应特定的财务异常模式。
AI.method: 1. 理论框架构建：基于荣格心理学识别四种阴影原型及其对应的财务表现；2. 实证验证：对100+学术研究进行交叉分析（包括PNAS研究显示创始人个性预测创业成功比行业因素强5倍）；3. 案例研究：分析Casper、Apple、Tesla等公司的实际案例；4. 量化相关性分析：如自恋CEO增加破产风险23%，完美主义降低增长率23%。
AI.findings: 1. 四种阴影原型与特定财务异常存在系统性对应关系；2. 创始人心理特征对财务表现有显著影响（自恋CEO增加23%破产风险，完美主义降低23%增长率）；3. 15%的人员效率低下会完全消除净利润；4. 传统技术修复无法解决这些根本的行为驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将荣格心理学阴影原型理论操作化并应用于企业财务分析，实现跨学科综合；2. 为创业研究提供了心理测量视角的损益表诊断框架；3. 建立了创始人心理模式与具体财务指标之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供"游戏化治疗"的12种行为设计干预措施（如客户电子宠物、救生艇战争游戏、功能税、自主树等）；2. 为从业者提供心理测量视角的损益表诊断工具；3. 帮助创始人将阴影冲动转化为建设性组织机制，超越传统的电子表格优化。

title: From Tools to Teammates: A Framework for Integrating AI Agents into Organizational Structures

detail.title: From Tools to Teammates: A Framework for Integrating AI Agents into Organizational Structures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a co‑founder of DialogAI, whose deployments are discussed as case examples in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable (no human subjects or sensitive data were involved).
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract:
Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed not just as productivity tools but as quasi‑members of organizational teams. Companies report that AI agents now draft software pull requests, resolve customer inquiries, qualify leads, and co‑create onboarding plans alongside human colleagues. Yet most management and information systems research still conceptualizes AI primarily as decision support or infrastructure, rather than as an organizational actor.

This working paper proposes a Three‑Level Maturity Framework for AI integration: Level 1 – AI as Tool, Level 2 – AI as Teammate, and Level 3 – AI as Workforce. The framework is grounded in public case evidence from software development, customer service, sales, marketing, and HR, combined with field observations from DialogAI deployments in customer‑facing environments and the author’s experience operating DialogAI as an “AI‑first” organization. A new metric, the Human–Agent Ratio (HAR), is introduced to quantify the depth of AI integration.

Findings suggest that most innovative organizations currently operate at Level 2, with AI agents performing roughly 40–60% of routine work in hybrid teams while humans focus on complex, relational, and strategic tasks. Customer‑facing scenarios introduce distinct challenges around trust, brand voice, and liability compared to internal use cases. The paper outlines practical design patterns for handoffs between humans and AI agents and identifies organizational readiness factors for moving beyond tool‑level adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个AI集成三层次成熟度框架（工具、队友、劳动力），引入人机比率（HAR）量化AI集成深度，发现创新组织多处于第二层次，AI代理完成40-60%常规工作，同时分析了面向客户场景的特殊挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何概念化和衡量AI在组织中的集成程度？组织如何从将AI视为工具转变为将其视为团队成员甚至劳动力？
AI.motivation: 当前管理和信息系统研究仍主要将AI概念化为决策支持或基础设施，而非组织参与者，但现实中AI代理已作为准团队成员参与软件开发、客户服务、销售、营销和人力资源等工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层次AI集成成熟度框架：第一层次-AI作为工具，第二层次-AI作为队友，第三层次-AI作为劳动力。引入人机比率（HAR）作为量化指标。
AI.method: 基于软件开发、客户服务、销售、营销和人力资源等领域的公开案例证据，结合DialogAI在面向客户环境中的实地观察，以及作者运营DialogAI作为"AI优先"组织的经验。
AI.findings: 大多数创新组织目前处于第二层次，AI代理在混合团队中完成约40-60%的常规工作，而人类专注于复杂、关系和战略任务。面向客户场景在信任、品牌声音和责任方面比内部用例面临更独特的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将AI概念化为组织参与者的新框架，超越了传统的决策支持视角。引入人机比率（HAR）作为量化AI集成深度的新指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人类与AI代理之间的交接提供了实用设计模式，识别了超越工具级采用的组织准备因素，为组织AI集成提供了实践指导。

title: Product Mix Optimization: A Decision Framework for Product Owners and Portfolio Managers

detail.title: Product Mix Optimization: A Decision Framework for Product Owners and Portfolio Managers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates how optimization can transform production planning from a capacity-driven exercise into a market- and profit-aware decision framework. By progressively layering capacity constraints, markups, contribution margins, and demand functions, the models show that profitability depends as much on market dynamics as on technical limits. The toolkit equips product owners and portfolio managers with a practical yet rigorous method to allocate production in ways that are technically feasible, financially sound, and strategically aligned.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何通过优化将生产规划从产能驱动转变为市场和利润导向的决策框架，通过分层建模帮助产品所有者和投资组合经理进行技术可行、财务稳健且战略一致的生产分配。
AI.research_question: 如何通过优化方法将生产规划从传统的产能驱动模式转变为市场导向和利润最大化的决策框架？
AI.motivation: 传统生产规划主要关注技术产能限制，忽视了市场动态和盈利能力，导致决策可能技术可行但财务不优或战略不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 优化理论、生产规划理论、市场导向决策框架、利润最大化理论
AI.method: 分层建模方法：逐步叠加产能约束、加价率、贡献边际和需求函数，构建综合优化模型
AI.findings: 盈利能力不仅取决于技术限制，同样受市场动态影响；优化方法能够实现技术可行、财务稳健且战略一致的生产分配决策
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将生产规划从产能驱动转变为市场利润导向的理论框架，扩展了优化理论在生产决策中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为产品所有者和投资组合经理提供了实用的工具包，帮助他们做出技术可行、财务稳健且战略一致的生产分配决策

title: Reforming the Automotive Regulatory Framework in Bangladesh: A Data-Driven Approach to Taxation, Modification, and Sustainability
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Reforming the Automotive Regulatory Framework in Bangladesh: A Data-Driven Approach to Taxation, Modification, and Sustainability
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the systemic inefficiencies within Bangladesh's automotive sector, specifically focusing on the outdated Motor Vehicle Ordinance of 1983. Despite significant global advancements in vehicle safety, engine efficiency, and electric vehicle (EV) technology, the current regulatory framework remains anchored in engine-capacity-based taxation and restrictive modification laws that hinder economic growth and citizen welfare. Drawing on a primary survey of 222 automotive stakeholders and enthusiasts, this study identifies a high level of dissatisfaction with the current Advance Income Tax (AIT) structure and the lack of depreciation-based taxation. Findings reveal that 76% of respondents feel restricted by current modification laws, often leading to law enforcement challenges. This paper proposes a comprehensive reform package, including a power-based (kW) taxation slab , an age-discounted AIT model , and a framework for the regularization of vehicle modifications based on safety and environmental impact. The proposed reforms aim to stimulate the adoption of low-emission vehicles while creating a more transparent and modern bureaucratic environment for vehicle owners.

AI.tldr: 本文研究孟加拉国汽车行业的系统性低效问题，重点关注1983年过时的《机动车条例》。尽管全球在车辆安全、发动机效率和电动汽车技术方面取得显著进步，但现行监管框架仍基于发动机排量征税和限制性改装法规，阻碍经济增长和公民福利。通过对222名汽车利益相关者和爱好者的调查，研究发现现行预缴所得税结构和缺乏基于折旧的税收制度引发高度不满。76%受访者感到受当前改装法规限制，常导致执法挑战。论文提出包括基于功率(kW)的税收分级、年龄折扣预缴所得税模型以及基于安全和环境影响的正规化车辆改装框架在内的全面改革方案。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国汽车行业的系统性低效问题及其监管改革方案是什么？具体而言，1983年《机动车条例》如何阻碍经济增长和公民福利，以及如何通过税收和改装法规改革来刺激低排放车辆采用并创建更透明的官僚环境？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球在车辆安全、发动机效率和电动汽车技术方面取得显著进步，但孟加拉国的监管框架仍停留在1983年的《机动车条例》，基于发动机排量征税和限制性改装法规，这种过时制度阻碍了经济增长和公民福利，需要系统性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于监管经济学和产业政策理论，探讨过时法规对行业发展的制约作用，以及税收政策对技术创新的激励效应。同时涉及行为经济学视角，分析利益相关者对现行制度的不满及其对合规行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法，包括对222名汽车利益相关者和爱好者的问卷调查，收集关于现行税收结构、改装法规和监管环境满意度的定量和定性数据，通过统计分析识别主要问题和改革需求。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 现行预缴所得税结构引发高度不满；2) 缺乏基于折旧的税收制度；3) 76%受访者感到受当前改装法规限制，常导致执法挑战；4) 过时的发动机排量基础税收制度阻碍低排放车辆采用。

title: Business Management Implications of Vendor Compliance and Retail Standardization in the U.S. Consumer Market

detail.title: Business Management Implications of Vendor Compliance and Retail Standardization in the U.S. Consumer Market

detail.abstract: Vendor compliance and retail standardization have become defining structural forces in the U.S. consumer market, fundamentally reshaping how consumer goods firms are managed and scaled. Large retailers increasingly impose standardized operational, logistical, and reporting requirements on vendors, extending their governance influence deep into supplier organizations. While these standards are often framed as efficiency-enhancing mechanisms, they introduce significant managerial, organizational, and strategic implications that remain underexplored in the business management literature. This paper examines the business management implications of vendor compliance and retail standardization, focusing on how standardized retail governance affects managerial decision-making, organizational design, and operational flexibility within consumer goods firms. Drawing on management, governance, and organizational control perspectives, the study develops a conceptual framework that explains how compliance requirements function not merely as operational constraints but as de facto governance mechanisms shaping firm behavior. The analysis highlights that vendor compliance generates both costs and strategic opportunities. While compliance imposes additional coordination burdens, resource allocation pressures, and risk exposure, it can also serve as a catalyst for managerial professionalization, internal control development, and organizational scalability. Firms that treat compliance reactively often experience strategic rigidity, whereas those that integrate compliance into core management systems are better positioned to convert standardization into a source of competitive advantage. By reframing vendor compliance as a central business management issue rather than a purely operational concern, this study contributes to a deeper understanding of retail governance in the U.S. consumer market. The findings offer actionable insights for executives navigating standardized retail environments and advance theoretical discussion on the intersection of governance, control, and strategy in contemporary consumer goods firms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国消费市场中供应商合规与零售标准化对消费品企业管理的影响，指出这些要求不仅是运营约束，更是塑造企业行为的治理机制，既能带来成本也能创造战略机会。
AI.research_question: 标准化零售治理如何影响消费品企业的管理决策、组织设计和运营灵活性？
AI.motivation: 供应商合规和零售标准化已成为美国消费市场的结构性力量，重塑了消费品企业的管理和规模化方式，但其管理、组织和战略影响在商业管理文献中尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于管理、治理和组织控制视角，构建概念框架，将合规要求解释为塑造企业行为的实际治理机制。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过理论框架构建和分析，探讨供应商合规的管理影响。
AI.findings: 供应商合规既产生成本也创造战略机会：一方面增加协调负担、资源分配压力和风险暴露；另一方面可促进管理专业化、内部控制发展和组织可扩展性。被动应对合规的企业往往面临战略僵化，而将合规整合到核心管理系统中的企业则能更好地将标准化转化为竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将供应商合规重新定义为商业管理的核心问题而非纯粹运营关注点，深化了对美国消费市场零售治理的理解，推进了关于当代消费品企业中治理、控制和战略交叉的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在标准化零售环境中运营的高管提供可操作的见解，帮助企业更好地将合规要求转化为竞争优势。

title: Foreign Peers in Higher Education: The Effects of Internationalization on Native Students' Academic Outcomes
affiliations: and

detail.title: Foreign Peers in Higher Education: The Effects of Internationalization on Native Students' Academic Outcomes

declarations.funderStatement: The author, Melisa Diaz Lema received funding from the Horizon Europe Framework (BRIDGE project, grant agreement number 101177154).

detail.abstract: Internationalization is widely promoted in higher education, yet it may entail tradeoffs for native students. While greater diversity can enhance the educational experience, changes in peer composition may reduce learning quality when students differ in cultural and academic backgrounds. This paper examines the effects of internationalization on the academic outcomes of native students. Using administrative panel data from a large public STEM university in Italy, we follow over 33,000 students across 17 programs and six cohorts. We exploit the introduction of an English parallel track in Civil Engineering using an instrumented difference-indifferences approach. The English track more than doubled the share of foreign students in the Civil Engineering program relative to the other primarily Italian-taught programs. We then examine the overall effect of expanding the English track and find that native students, regardless of whether they enroll in the Italian or English track, are less likely to drop out and more likely to graduate on time, although they achieve a slightly lower GPA. Further analysis of mechanisms reveals that international student inflows drive graduation gains, while larger classes and other changes to the learning environment explain the GPA decline. Our findings indicate that internationalization policies can improve native students' persistence and timely degree completion in higher education.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用意大利一所大型公立STEM大学的行政面板数据，通过工具变量双重差分法分析国际化对本地学生学业成果的影响。研究发现，国际化政策（引入英语平行课程）提高了本地学生的坚持率和按时毕业率，尽管GPA略有下降。
AI.research_question: 国际化对本地学生的学业成果有何影响？具体来说，引入英语平行课程（增加国际学生比例）如何影响本地学生的辍学率、按时毕业率和GPA？
AI.motivation: 高等教育国际化被广泛推广，但可能对本地学生产生权衡。虽然多样性可以增强教育体验，但同伴构成的变化可能因文化和学术背景差异而降低学习质量。需要实证证据来理解国际化对本地学生的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同伴效应理论、教育生产函数理论和国际化教育理论，探讨同伴构成变化（国际学生流入）对本地学生学习成果的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用意大利一所大型公立STEM大学的行政面板数据，追踪17个专业、6个队列的33,000多名学生。采用工具变量双重差分法，利用土木工程专业引入英语平行课程的准自然实验，比较该专业与其他意大利语授课专业的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 英语课程使土木工程专业的国际学生比例增加一倍以上；2. 本地学生（无论选择意大利语还是英语课程）辍学率降低，按时毕业率提高；3. 本地学生GPA略有下降；4. 国际学生流入驱动了毕业率的提升，而班级规模扩大和学习环境变化解释了GPA下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为高等教育国际化对本地学生影响的争论提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了国际化影响的不同维度（坚持率、毕业率、GPA）可能呈现不同方向；3. 识别了国际学生流入和班级规模变化两种不同的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高等教育机构制定国际化政策提供实证依据；2. 表明国际化政策可以改善本地学生的坚持率和按时毕业率；3. 提醒政策制定者注意班级规模和学习环境变化可能带来的GPA下降风险；4. 支持在STEM领域推广英语授课课程。

detail.abstract: Black Eagle MAR-X7 presents the conceptual design, prototyping, and operational vision of a next-generation fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) developed with a strong emphasis on aerodynamic efficiency, structural robustness, and modular adaptability. The MAR-X7 integrates a carbon-fiber airframe, compact propulsion architecture, and simplified control mechanisms to achieve high endurance, stability at high altitude, and low structural weight. This book documents the evolution of the prototype from early physical modeling to exhibition-ready configurations, highlighting key design decisions related to wing geometry, propulsion placement, materials engineering, and system integration. Beyond the technical aspects, Black Eagle MAR-X7 explores the broader role of advanced UAV platforms in surveillance, research, and future aerospace innovation. The work contributes to the growing field of applied drone engineering by bridging experimental prototyping with conceptual system design, offering insights valuable to researchers, engineers, and innovators in unmanned aerial systems.

title: Innovation Acceleration Toolkit Hong Kong as a Focal Case: A Toolkit for Diagnosing and Accelerating Innovation Ecosystems

detail.title: Innovation Acceleration Toolkit Hong Kong as a Focal Case: A Toolkit for Diagnosing and Accelerating Innovation Ecosystems
detail.abstract: Innovation ecosystems often underperform not because of insufficient resources, but because actors lack a shared diagnostic framework for interpreting bottlenecks, aligning incentives, and sequencing interventions. This working paper introduces the Innovation Acceleration Toolkit, a three-part method designed to support ecosystem diagnosis and coordinated action. The Toolkit combines the Innovation Pentagon Model (for system mapping), the Innovation Maturity Model (for capability and integration assessment), and the Innovation Acceleration Canvas (for translating diagnosis into actionable strategies). To illustrate the Toolkit's application, Hong Kong is used as a focal case, integrating insights from expert interviews, ecosystem data, and comparative analysis. Findings highlight structural challenges related to commercialization pathways, early-stage financing, talent retention, and institutional coordination. While Hong Kong provides the empirical demonstration, the Toolkit is generalizable and intended for broader use across innovation ecosystems seeking to improve translational capacity and research-to-market outcomes. The contribution of this work lies in offering a practical, practitioner-oriented method for diagnosing innovation bottlenecks and designing ecosystemlevel interventions.
